manifest.creator: Daqing Chen
manifest.note: Historical snapshot; no live feed or simulated incidents. Source catalog says no missing values, but workbook has missing CustomerID and Description; workbook profile controls.

currency.provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
currency.method: Multiply every invoice group by the monthly average USD per GBP for its transaction month, then aggregate. Historical analytical translation, not actual settlement rates. December 2011 uses its full-month average although transactions end December 9.

rules.label: Customer ID missing
rules.interpretation: Limits customer-level analysis; not proof of a bad sale
rules.action: Keep financial record; exclude from identified-customer metrics

rules.label: Description missing
rules.interpretation: Limits product interpretation; may be an inventory adjustment
rules.action: Review source and product reference; do not invent a description

rules.label: Exact duplicate candidate
rules.interpretation: Repeated full source row after the first occurrence; no source line key
rules.action: Reconcile with original invoice before removing any rows

rules.label: Zero unit price
rules.interpretation: May represent adjustments or free items; needs context
rules.action: Separate from positive-priced sales and investigate

rules.label: Negative unit price
rules.interpretation: May be a manual adjustment; incompatible with standard sale assumptions
rules.action: Review accounting context; retain source record

rules.label: Non-cancellation negative quantity
rules.interpretation: Negative units without C prefix; may be inventory adjustment
